findings: components[1].sound: The cited Zhengzhang-style comparison gives 乞 as *kʰɯds or *kʰɯd, but the entry selects only *kʰɯd(s), which is not one of the cited forms. Use a cited reading for 乞 (for example, *kʰɯd) and retain 吃 *kɯd; the evidence supports their similarity, not identity. [X-3778b5679d4585dce9f7]
